items.question: The derivative of sin x is?
The gradient of the tangent to y = x^2 at x = 3 is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Differentiate y = 4x^3 - 6x + 2 with respect to x. (4 marks)
2. Using the graph in the diagram, estimate the gradient of the curve at x = 2. (4 marks)
3. Find the area under the curve y = 2x between x = 0 and x = 3. (5 marks)
4. Solve the equation: 2sin x - 1 = 0 for 0 <= x <= 180. (4 marks)
5. Calculate the standard deviation of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. (6 marks)
